contexts.text: Omnipotence is predicated from the Quantity of magnitude; and Omniscience from the Quantity of multitude.
Truth is there presented in a discrete Quantity...
A quantity sufficient for everyone. Signified, Explained. AC 8533.
The quantity of the good. Signified, Explained.
By the quantity both of measure and of weight is signified the correspondence.
In proportion as-quantum- a man shuns evils as sins, in the same proportion he does goods... from the Lord. DLife 32. DLife 42. DLife 67. DLife 74. DLife 80. DLife 87. BE 84. TCR 330.
